description: Change of use from Public House (Sui generis) to commercial unit (Class E) involving single-storey side extension.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan; Block Plan; Design and Access Statement; Fire Statement; Marketing report; Highway Impact Statement; Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS) Supporting Statement; Flood Risk Assessment; Biodiversity Metric Calculation Tool; A112 Rev A; A113 Rev A; A107 Rev A; A108; A109 Rev A; A110 Rev A; A111 Rev A.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended), or any order revoking or re-enacting those Orders, the premises shall be used only for purposes falling within Use Class E and for no other purpose.Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of nearby residential properties.

The development shall not be occupied until details of refuse storage facilities including facilities for the recycling of waste to be provided within the development, in accordance with the London Borough of Enfield - Waste and Recycling Planning Storage Guidance ENV 08/162, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details before the development is occupied or use commences.Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction targets.

The long stay cycle parking spaces hereby approved shall be provided  in accordance with the approved details and thereafter permanently retained and available for use unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure the provision of cycle parking in line with the Council's adopted standards.

Prior to the installation of any mechanical ventilation or other plant associated with the Class E operation of the building, an acoustic report must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The report must set out the sound level generated from any mechanical plant, and state the noise control measures to be employed to ensure the noise from the combined units does not exceed a level of 5dB below background noise levels at the façade of the nearest or most noise affected residential property. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure there is not an unreasonable negative environmental impact.

The approved development shall only be open between the hours of 08:00 to 23:30 Monday to Fridays and 08:00 to 23:30 on Saturdays and 09:00 to 22:00 on Sundays or bank holidays.Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of nearby residential properties.

Deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site only between the hours of 06:00 to 23:30 Monday to Fridays and 06:00 to 23:30 on Saturdays and 06:00 to 23:30 on Sundays or bank holidays..Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of nearby residential properties.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

No plant or equipment shall be affixed to any external face of a building or added to the roof of a building other than that shown in the approved drawings.Reason: In the interest of amenity and to ensure a satisfactory external appearance in accordance with policy D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Policy (2014).

The premises hereby approved for Class E use shall be occupied as a single business unit only and shall not be subdivided or occupied by more than one business, nor shall separate units be created within the building, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To prevent the over-intensive use of the site, to ensure that appropriate parking, servicing and access arrangements can be satisfactorily maintained, and to safeguard the character and amenity of the surrounding area, in accordance with the Development Plan.
